descriptor: Brand, web and product design studio

voice.summary: Keep Studio sounds like a design partner who has seen enough fads: direct, a little dry and sure of its taste. It states what it makes and for whom in one line.
dos: Lead with what the studio makes

taglines: Brands, sites and products that last
boilerplate: Keep Studio is an independent studio that designs brands, websites and products for companies that make things people keep, with a project index spanning web, brand, motion and product.

microcopy.success: Message received. We reply within two days.
microcopy.error: That did not send. Email us directly instead.

logo.note: A strong initial is enough for a studio whose idea is keeping things.
